verses.gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਹ ਦੈ ਘਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੜਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: chor giaa ghar saeh dhai ghar a(n)dhar vaRiaa|

en.bdb: A thief entered the house of a rich person.
Carefully watching the four corners he came to the upper room.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਪੰਡ ਬੰਨੑਹਿ ਅਗਲਾਈ ਅੜਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: suinaa rupaa pa(n)dd ba(n)n(h)h agalaiee aRiaa|

en.bdb: He gathered the money and gold and tied them in a bundle; but still his greed delayed him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਹਲਕਾਇਆ ਲੂਣ ਹਾਂਡਾ ਫੜਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: lobh lahar halakaiaa loon haa(n)ddaa faRiaa|

en.bdb: Getting impatient in greed he caught hold of a salt-pot.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੁਖਕੁ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਚਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਖੁ ਨ ਖੜਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: chukhak lai ke chakhiaa tis kakh na khaRiaa|

en.bdb: A bit of it he took out and tasted; he left every thing there and came, out.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰੁ ਧੜੁ ਧੰਮੜ ਧੜਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: loon haraamee gunahagaar dhaR dha(n)maR dhaRiaa ||10||

en.bdb: That thief also knew, that an ungrateful person is beaten like a drum (in the Lord's court).
